lines.say: Your mother's plan doubled. Two hundred forty dollars. Thirty days.
Doris knocks. She brings a notebook.
She writes down every floor. Not for the tower.
Ten cents a day, from twelve hundred homes.
Day thirty. The machine runs on neighbors.
Your mother smiles. Her care belongs to no tower.
Above the city, the owner sends a fine. One million dollars.
Would you sign the notebook? Write it in the comments.
